description: Reviewed follow-up configurations. Timestep comparison completed on Unity; GPU restart gate and longer pair are prepared, not yet run.

maintenance_pair.matched_initial_state_basis: Identical grid, planet, physics, initial, boundary, numerics and experiment seed; experiment name is a label and convection.enabled affects subsequent impulses, not the initial fields.
maintenance_pair.nominal_circuit_definition: 2*pi*initial.jet_radius_m/initial.jet_speed_m_s; nominal profile values, not a fitted realized circulation period or pattern rotation period.
maintenance_pair.purpose: Paired seeded-hexagon maintenance comparison; does not test spontaneous emergence or preferential selection of mode six.

required_gates_before_scientific_interpr.action: Compare the 50 s nominal timestep run against the 100 s Unity benchmark over their common 20,000 s interval, with realized output times and event timing accounted for.
Verify continuous versus checkpoint-resumed GPU evolution using the same configuration, source, runtime and dependencies; a successful checkpoint write alone is insufficient.

remaining_limits: One paired seed and about one nominal jet circuit do not establish long-term stabilization.
Forcing-radius, resolution, boundary and longer-duration sensitivity remain required for physical claims.
Both maintenance runs must start from the same initialized state rather than sharing a forced evolved checkpoint.
Choose a new output directory for every run, including the timestep check whose experiment.name intentionally matches the benchmark.
This JSON is metadata, not a runner configuration; submit only the three explicit TOML paths listed above.

configuration_validation.method: Existing SaturnPolarQG.load_config applied to each explicitly listed TOML; no model allocation or integration.

timestep_evidence.interpretation: Very small short-time sensitivity supports retaining dt100 for the exploratory pair; no convergence-order or long-time claim.
